name: Tartyx River
description: The river that marks the boundary between the mortal realm and the Underworld, formed from five tributaries.

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first mortal to escape the land of the dead by using the Tartyx's waters to strip himself of identity.
timeline.quote: Phenax was the first mortal to find a route of escape out of the land of the dead

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first to escape the Underworld through the Tartyx and ascends to godhood.
timeline.quote: Once a mortal soul, Phenax became the first to escape the Underworld by journeying through the Tartyx River.
